WirelessAdapterScope: Optional R2026a wireless-clock candidate; runtime validation pending
ProbeScope: Symbol discovery only; licenses and execution are not validated.
Routing: Per-node ARL neighbor admission, autonomous route propagation and forwarding
SecurityAssumption: Decoded admission and routing controls are trusted simulation inputs; no authentication, encryption, keys or replay protection.
FaultInjection: Optional deterministic post-PHY receive erasures before MAC/HOP/NWK; default none
LinkEvents: Post-PHY RF blackout at receive completion; protocol timers keep running

MetricDefinitions.Dropped: Provisional unique-application loss after all registered NWK custody is released; not final loss while a MAC copy remains live
MetricDefinitions.Transmitted: OTA aggregate transmissions across all nodes, including control
MetricDefinitions.PhysicalTransmissions: OTA aggregate transmissions, including control-only frames
MetricDefinitions.PhysicalAttempts: OTA transmission at each non-self receiver
MetricDefinitions.PhysicalDropped: Failed receiver observations, including optional post-PHY erasures
MetricDefinitions.PhyTrace: Raw source PHY decisions plus explicitly named post_phy_drop erasure rows
MetricDefinitions.Collisions: Completed receiver-signal observations with overlap, not forced packet losses
MetricDefinitions.QueueDrops: New source applications dropped by bounded forwarding custody queue
MetricDefinitions.QueueAdmissionRejections: Source or relay queue admission refusals, including retried refusals
MetricDefinitions.AcksReceived: HOP DATA transactions acknowledged by ACK feedback, not raw ACK frames
MetricDefinitions.DacksReceived: HOP DATA transactions accepted through DACK feedback
MetricDefinitions.UnconfirmedHopTransfers: Hop feedback failure while another NWK occurrence is retained or the application is already delivered or provisionally dropped
MetricDefinitions.RelayAccepted: Accepted relay NWK custody occurrences; multiple copies of one application each count
MetricDefinitions.UnretainedHopAcks: ACK/DACK completion with no registered NWK custody and no unique delivery; provisional loss recoverable by late reception
